title: Protected-path edit prompt in acceptEdits offers '2 Yes, and switch to accept edits … for this session' though the session is already in accept edits
observed: kiln defect (UX). In --permission-mode acceptEdits, asking Opus to add a [user] section to .git/config with the edit tool, and to write .claude/settings.json, both prompted correctly with the note '<path> is a protected path: changing it can run code or change permissions later, so it always needs the user's approval.' Both prompts still offered '2  Yes, and switch to accept edits (auto-approve file edits and common file commands) for this session (shift+tab)'. Choosing 2 for .claude/settings.json wrote the file and left the mode unchanged. The option is a no-op, and it suggests accept edits would have covered this path, which it never does.
expected: Leave out option 2 when the mode is already acceptEdits (and on a protected path, where switching modes cannot pre-approve the next one); offer Yes / No.
